summary: Serve the full ACM range catalog in production lookups
description: Integrate the generated ACM range database with the canonical NL adapter and Vercel build so production lookups use all current register ranges while preserving the existing pinned public-safe fallback and neutral evidence semantics.
acceptance: When the generated catalog exists, NL lookups query all imported ranges by canonical E.164 interval and emit only number type and regulatory status with record-level provenance and current freshness.

Missing, stale, invalid, or unavailable production catalogs fail closed to typed gaps or the documented public-safe fixture path; range holder, subscriber, provider, caller, and safety claims are never fabricated.
The Vercel production build creates and bundles the checksum-pinned catalog without committing the database or downloaded CSV.
verification: uv run pytest tests/adapters/test_nl.py tests/integration/test_lookup.py tests/e2e/test_web.py -q
